description: Record a loan or lease and return its id, level payment and effective annual rate. principal_minor, fees and balloon are whole MINOR units; rate_bps is the nominal annual rate in basis points. Free: 3 agreements.

balloon_minor.description: Final balloon or residual value in whole minor units, due with the last payment and not inside it. Default 0

currency.description: ISO code the agreement is denominated in

fees_minor.description: Arrangement fees in whole minor units, paid at drawdown. Default 0

lender.description: Who the money is owed to

method.description: annuity for a level payment, straight-principal for equal principal and a falling payment

name.description: What this agreement is, e.g. Van finance or Office lease

payment_frequency.description: How often a payment falls due

principal_minor.description: Amount borrowed, in whole minor units (integer cents). 1,000,000 is EUR 10,000.00

rate_bps.description: Nominal annual interest rate in basis points. 1200 is 12 percent. Zero is allowed

start_date.description: Drawdown date, YYYY-MM-DD. The first payment falls one period after it

term_periods.description: Number of payment periods, not years

name: loan_create
title: Record a loan or lease
